'''RK-7''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] serving the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]]. He was the commander of ten other battle droids.

During the battle, [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] assigned RK-7 and its troops to secure [[Gode Takrab]]'s [[Gode Takrab's shuttle|shuttle]], to aid to Takrab's mission or, should it fail, to Gunray's further purposes. RK-7 did his best to stop the [[Naboo Resistance]] to take over the shuttle, even if RK-7 did not know the real details of the mission.
